descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Flight Simulator Amsterdam puts you in the captain's seat over the real Amsterdam.

THE REAL AMSTERDAM
Real satellite, elevation and map data: the canal ring, Centraal Station, the Royal Palace on the Dam, the Westerkerk, the Rijksmuseum, the Magere Brug, the A'DAM Tower, NEMO, the Johan Cruijff ArenA, Muiderslot, IJmuiden's sea locks and Zandvoort. Schiphol with all six runways, and Lelystad.

WINDMILLS AND TULIPS
Hundreds of real windmills and wind turbines, their sails turning. Fly over the striped tulip fields of the Bollenstreek, the dunes and the North Sea beach.

A LIVING CITY
Yellow-and-blue trains on their real tracks, the metro on its viaduct, ferries and canal boats on the IJ, ships off IJmuiden. At night the canals light up.

AIR TRAFFIC CONTROL
Taxi and takeoff clearances, traffic calls and your landing clearance.

ENGLISH AND DUTCH
Switch every menu between English and Dutch in Settings.

YOUR GLASS HANGAR
Every flight starts in your glass hangar on the IJ, the A'DAM Tower out of the doors. Walk around, repaint, wash, fly.

FOUR AIRCRAFT
Two private jets with walk-through cabins, a midsize jet with yokes and a twin-engine fighter.

ELEVEN MISSIONS
The Polderbaan approach, the Amstel and IJ run, through the windmills, tulips and dunes, a fighter scramble, the canals after dark and a city tour.

FLY TOGETHER ONLINE
Quick Match or a private sky with a code. Voice chat stays off until you turn it on.
